summary: Ansible 11.0.0 deprecations: community.network removed from Ansible 12 unless maintained, and google.cloud and sensu.sensu_go to be removed from Ansible 12 for sanity failures. Both remain installable via ansible-galaxy.
questions: Can I still install google.cloud after it's removed from the package?

answer_card.title: Ansible 12 removal candidates
answer_card.answer_md:
- `community.network`: removed from Ansible 12 unless maintained.
- `google.cloud` and `sensu.sensu_go`: scheduled for removal from Ansible 12 due to sanity test failures. After removal, install them with `ansible-galaxy collection install <name>`. (The google.cloud removal was later cancelled.)
